lines.text: The songwriter says it is good to praise the LORD with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
The songwriter says the LORD has made him glad by His deeds, and that His thoughts are deep.
Though the wicked sprout like grass, they will be forever destroyed, and the LORD's enemies will be gathered.
The LORD has exalted the songwriter's horn like that of a wild ox, and his eyes see the downfall of his enemies.
The righteous will flourish like a palm tree and grow like a cedar in Sinai, planted in the house of the LORD.
